findings.title: validate-design is only a tool-presence smoke test
findings.detail: The spec requires schema validation for architecture schemas, the ADR register, capability matrix, and evidence manifest, plus ADR/capability-matrix validation scripts. The delivered entrypoint only runs version/import-metadata checks and never reads /workspace/docs, validates a schema, or invokes a design-validation script. AC3 is therefore satisfied only at the pathname/tool-presence level.
findings.evidence: ci-architecture.md:72 requires the validation behavior; validate-design:94-124 contains only executable checks for tool versions and package metadata.

findings.title: Build-time network is not limited to the AC5 allowlist
findings.detail: The build performs apt-get update/install, reaching Debian mirrors, and downloads Node.js from nodejs.org. Neither endpoint is in AC5's exact allowlist of pypi.org, files.pythonhosted.org, and registry.npmjs.org. Documentation of the extra endpoint does not enforce a network policy.
findings.evidence: A fresh podman build log showed deb.debian.org traffic during apt-get and curl https://nodejs.org/dist/... during the Node install; Containerfile:136-138 explicitly acknowledges nodejs.org as an added endpoint.

findings.title: Reproducibility is demonstrated only by coarse metrics, not by a locked image build
findings.detail: Apt package versions, pip transitives, and npm transitives are resolved from mutable repositories at build time. Two no-cache builds matched pip freeze and file counts, but image sizes were 770379222 and 770379221 bytes and image digests differed (sha256:812c30e1... versus sha256:a4c8b8d5...). The narrow AC8 probes pass, but they do not prove stable image content or bit-reproducible rebuilds.
findings.evidence: podman image inspect reported different IDs, sizes, and digests for the two --no-cache builds; Containerfile:276-279 explicitly records non-reproducible image digests, while requirements.txt leaves transitive resolution to pip.
